about_short_description.short_description: Hammr is a platform for the construction industry that provides time tracking, payroll, benefits, and compliance.

product.name: Certified Payroll Reporting
product.description: Software to generate certified payroll reports compliant with prevailing wage laws, including WH-347 forms, with one-click automation.

product.name: Time-Tracking App
product.description: A mobile and desktop app for field workers to log hours easily, supporting multiple projects, wage calculations, and compliance.

product.name: Payroll Management
product.description: Platform to manage payroll processing with support for multiple pay rates, prevailing wages, union rates, and fringe benefits.

product.name: Scheduling Tool
product.description: Tool to assign employees and crews to projects efficiently, streamlining workforce management.

product.name: Team Communication App
product.description: Built-in messaging platform for organized communication among project teams, crews, and office staff.

product.name: Benefits Administration
product.description: Platform to offer and manage employee benefits, streamlining enrollment and tracking.
